budget_items.what_was_recorded: Skate Park Committee members reported fundraising amounts, including a pledge and a total approaching a goal.
budget_items.quote: miles for myles has pledged $3000 to us. we are almost at the $50,000 mark.

budget_items.topic: Skate park matching funds and new goal
budget_items.what_was_recorded: A bank promised a gift and foundation matching funds were sought, and the committee set a new fundraising goal after downsizing the park design.
budget_items.quote: they have promised $2500 towards the skate park. he is also a trustee for the crocker and wallace foundation and will attempt to obtain $20,000 in matching funds from crocker and $30,000 in matching funds from wallace.

budget_items.topic: FY20 budget recommendation for facilities and roads
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager evaluation states the FY20 budget recommendation adds money to the facilities and town roads accounts.
budget_items.quote: the fy20 budget recommendation includes an additional $40,000 for maintenance of facilities and an additional $50,000 in the town roads account.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The evaluation reports the Town recouped a sum from a tax lien sale of delinquent taxes.

budget_items.topic: Regionalization and Efficiency grant for Animal Control
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The evaluation says the Town Manager helped obtain a state grant for the regional animal control feasibility work.
budget_items.quote: heather helped in the application process in order to receive a grant through the regionalization and efficiency grant program for $42,000

budget_items.topic: Regional Animal Control Facility design cost
budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Townsend Town Administrator relayed that the estimated design cost was too prohibitive to move forward; no figure was printed.
budget_items.quote: the estimated cost for the design of a regional animal control facility

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The DPW Director reported about $500,000 of paving completed in the last month.
budget_items.quote: they have done about $500,000 of paving in the last month

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The Town Manager proposed applying for a MassDEP grant to fund a recycling education campaign and an 8-week curbside check.
budget_items.quote: the grant award is up to $20,000 and up to 40 hours of technical assistance from our massdep municipal assistance coordinator.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: The evaluation says health plan changes reduced OPEB liability costs; the amount was described only as millions.
budget_items.quote: reduced the town's opeb liability costs by millions due to these plan changes
